districtPolicy: Gdovsky District and other internal Russian administrative boundary strokes retain their original coordinates. Land fills exclude water; water masking does not move district boundaries.
policy: Baltic international boundary from official Estonian/Lithuanian administrative geometry. Russian land fills and exterior display edge follow it; original internal administrative strokes, including Gdovsky District, are retained verbatim. Full OSM lake shoreline is a land mask, not a new administrative boundary.
